STORYTIME ADVENTURE 14 · CLASS 29

Rabbit’s Hidden Clues

Age 4–5 YearsClass 29 · StorytimeSkill What do you need?

Snowy, rainy, hungry — read Rabbit’s clues and tap the thing Rabbit needs.

Play the story game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · WHAT DO YOU NEED?

Rabbit’s Hidden Clues

Look at each clue, then tap what Rabbit needs.

Rabbit is cold in the snow. What does Rabbit need?

It is raining and Rabbit’s feet are wet. What does Rabbit need?

Rabbit’s tummy is rumbling. What does Rabbit need?

Three needs found!

A warm coat for snow, an umbrella for rain, a sandwich for hunger.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains what do you need? on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Rabbit’s Hidden Clues worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
